docs.title: Lighting a Lantern
docs.text: A player lights a lantern by spending one spark token during the Lighting phase. A lit lantern scores two points at dusk.

docs.title: Wind Gusts
docs.text: On a wind gust, every unsecured lantern is extinguished. Secured lanterns remain lit.

docs.title: Securing
docs.text: A player may secure one of their lit lanterns by spending an anchor token. Secured lanterns cannot be extinguished by wind.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: A resource token used only to light lanterns.

docs.title: Passing the Baton
docs.text: A runner may pass the baton only while both runners occupy the same bank space. The receiver becomes the active runner.

docs.title: River Current
docs.text: Moving downstream costs one stamina. Moving upstream costs two stamina. Diagonal bank hops are illegal.

docs.title: Finish Line
docs.text: The team that carries the baton into the finish hex wins. If the baton is dropped in the water, reset it to the last bank space.
A picker may harvest at most three apples per turn from trees they control.
Shared trees may be harvested by any picker, but each apple taken from a shared tree costs one favor token.

docs.title: Favor
docs.text: A token representing goodwill with the orchard warden; spent to harvest shared trees.
